caption:
Your body destroys its own messengers on purpose 🧬 A signal that never stops isn't a signal, it's noise — so some of them last about four minutes. Lab versions borrow a fatty acid to ride on blood proteins and last days instead. That one trick is why some medicines are weekly rather than hourly.
